title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Low back pain.

HPI
Pt is an 89 y.o. male presenting for evaluation of chronic low back pain. Reports dull, aching pain in lumbar region for several months. Pain is exacerbated by prolonged standing or walking. Denies radiation of pain to lower extremities, numbness, or weakness. No recent falls or acute trauma. Pt seeks management for symptom relief.

Medication List
Multivitamin, 1 tab daily.

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Lungs: Clear to auscultation.
MSK: Lumbar spine: Mild tenderness to palpation over paraspinal muscles. Range of motion limited by discomfort. No focal neurological deficits noted. Gait steady.

Assessment
1. Low back pain.

Plan
1. Conservative management. Recommended stretching and heat therapy.
2. Follow up PRN if symptoms worsen.

Problem List
- status post appendectomy
- status post cholecystectomy
- major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate

Electronically signed, D. Kowalski, DO, 05/12/2026
explanations: Depression appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
